prompt:
You are a senior financial analyst on the Media & Entertainment coverage team at a bulge bracket investment bank. Your managing director has asked you to prepare a quarterly performance review and variance analysis for Walt Disney Co. (DIS) covering the period from Q1 FY2026 to Q2 FY2026, alongside full-year FY2025 benchmarks. The analysis will be presented to the sector head and used as a basis for updating our coverage model.

Materials provided:
- The attached XBRL financial data extract for Walt Disney Co. (CIK 0001744489) containing revenue, operating income, net income, EPS, SG&A, total assets, stockholders' equity, and cash balances for Q1 FY2026, Q2 FY2026, FY2025, and Q3 FY2025.

Task requirements:
1. Build an Excel workbook with the following tabs: 'Revenue Analysis', 'Profitability', 'Balance Sheet', 'EPS Analysis', and 'Summary Dashboard'.
2. On the 'Revenue Analysis' tab, calculate: (a) Q2 FY2026 revenue of $25,168M, (b) Q1 FY2026 revenue of $25,981M, (c) the quarter-over-quarter change in dollars and percentage, (d) FY2025 full-year revenue of $94,425M, and (e) Q3 FY2025 revenue of $71,961M with its implied annualized run-rate.
3. On the 'Profitability' tab, calculate: (a) Q2 FY2026 and Q1 FY2026 operating income and net income, (b) operating margin and net margin for both quarters, (c) quarter-over-quarter changes in dollars and percentages for both metrics, (d) FY2025 operating income of $17,551M and net income of $12,404M for full-year reference, and (e) FY2025 operating margin and net margin.
4. On the 'Balance Sheet' tab, present total assets, stockholders' equity, and cash for Q2 FY2026, Q1 FY2026, and FY2025, with quarter-over-quarter changes.
5. On the 'EPS Analysis' tab, calculate Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $1.27, Q1 FY2026 diluted EPS of $1.34, the QoQ change, FY2025 full-year diluted EPS of $6.85, and Q3 FY2025 diluted EPS of $6.12.
6. On the 'Summary Dashboard' tab, create a one-page executive summary table showing key metrics (revenue, operating income, net income, operating margin, net margin, EPS, total assets, equity, cash) for Q2 FY2026, Q1 FY2026, and FY2025, with QoQ variance columns.
7. All dollar figures must be displayed in millions with one decimal place. All percentages must be formatted to two decimal places. All QoQ calculations must use the formula (Q2 - Q1) / Q1.
8. Use consistent color coding: input cells in light blue, calculated cells in light green, and header rows in dark blue with white font.
